description: This file is a Python module for handling video processing tasks within a larger software project. It includes functions for extracting and embedding metadata, generating thumbnails, extracting MPEG-7 signatures, scene detection, and computing scene-specific video signatures. The module interacts with external tools like ffmpeg and ffprobe via the iscc_sdk library, and references other internal modules such as iscc_core.

methods.name: video_meta_extract
methods.description: Extracts video metadata using ffprobe and ffmpeg, combining results into a single metadata dictionary.

methods.name: video_meta_extract_ffprobe
methods.description: Uses ffprobe to extract detailed video stream information and metadata.

methods.name: video_meta_extract_ffmpeg
methods.description: Uses ffmpeg to extract metadata from a video file and maps it to the internal schema.

methods.name: video_meta_embed
methods.description: Embeds specified metadata into a copy of the video file, returning the path to the new file.

methods.name: video_thumbnail
methods.description: Generates a thumbnail image from a video file.

methods.name: video_features_extract
methods.description: Extracts a sequence of video frame signatures for similarity hashing.

methods.name: video_mp7sig_extract
methods.description: Extracts an MPEG-7 signature from a video file.

methods.name: video_mp7sig_extract_scenes
methods.description: Extracts MPEG-7 signatures and scene cutpoints from a video.

methods.name: video_parse_scenes
methods.description: Parses scene detection output to determine scene cutpoints.

methods.name: video_compute_granular
methods.description: Computes scene-specific video signatures based on frames and scene cutpoints.
